benchbox/sql_compat/rules/query_adapter/clickhouse_session_policy.py registers three rules (TPC-DS q23a, q23b and q87) that set joined_subquery_requires_alias=0 as a session policy instead of rewriting the SQL, because AST-based alias injection corrupts Q23 GROUP BY and inserts aliases inside Q87 EXCEPT/INTERSECT. If no upstream issue is appropriate, record the reason in the rule's reason text instead of a comment.
